description: Committed, policy-grounded registry of General Availability (GA) blockers for Monday Report. The GA readiness gate emits exactly one check per entry and derives blocker counts from these categories, so a known-but-unimplemented control is a declared BLOCKED entry that keeps GA red rather than an invisible gap. No waiver can resolve a blocker in this version (verified per-user identity and signature verification do not yet exist).

blockers.label: Authenticated per-user identity
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/auth.py (single shared MONDAY_REPORT_API_KEY; no per-user credentials)
blockers.resolution_condition: Authenticated per-user credentials replace the single shared API key and the request actor is derived from the caller's identity.
blockers.description: The whole auth surface is one shared static API key; there is no per-user identity. Required before any per-user attribution or RBAC can be trusted.

blockers.label: RBAC and role separation
blockers.policy_reference: docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md (RBAC goal); benchmark_permissions() maps a single all-role configured user
blockers.resolution_condition: Distinct roles with enforced least privilege exist and route authorization checks a per-user role, not the single configured all-role user.
blockers.description: The configured user always holds ADMIN/ENGINEER/VALIDATOR; there is no role separation or least-privilege enforcement.

blockers.label: Per-request tenant authorization enforcement
blockers.policy_reference: single-tenant-per-process store singleton; no per-request tenant resolution from the credential
blockers.resolution_condition: Tenant is resolved from the authenticated request and enforced at the API layer (with Postgres RLS active for the normalized store).
blockers.description: The process serves one configured tenant; there is no per-request tenant authorization boundary.

blockers.label: Verified per-user reviewer identity (AUDIT-001)
blockers.policy_reference: docs/FIELD_CORRECTIONS.md (actor_source='configured', AUDIT-001 not closed)
blockers.resolution_condition: Correction/validation outcomes attribute a verified authenticated human, not the configured actor context.
blockers.description: Review/correction outcomes are attributed to the single configured actor; no verified reviewer identity exists.

blockers.label: Keyed audit-chain integrity
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/store.py _audit_event_hash (plain unkeyed sha256)
blockers.resolution_condition: Audit entry hashes are computed with a managed secret key (HMAC), so a state-file writer cannot forge a valid chain.
blockers.description: The audit hash chain is unkeyed SHA-256; anyone who can write the state can recompute a valid chain. Not tamper-resistant.

blockers.label: Audit tail-truncation detection
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/store.py audit_integrity_status (no external count/head anchor)
blockers.resolution_condition: An externally persisted append-only anchor (event count + head hash) exists so deleting trailing events breaks integrity verification.
blockers.description: Deleting the most recent N audit events leaves an internally consistent chain that still verifies as sealed; truncation is undetectable.

blockers.label: Cross-process correction atomicity
blockers.policy_reference: docs/FIELD_CORRECTIONS.md (in-process lock only; Phase 04 pending)
blockers.resolution_condition: Correction lineage integrity is guaranteed across processes via normalized persistence with row/advisory locking or a uniqueness constraint.
blockers.description: The field-correction lineage invariant holds only in-process; the local JSON snapshot is last-writer-wins across processes.

blockers.label: Database migration runner
blockers.policy_reference: docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md S1-08 (migration runner); no runner exists
blockers.resolution_condition: A migration runner with a schema_migrations/version table applies db/migrations/ deterministically and idempotently.
blockers.description: Migrations are raw .sql applied by hand; the Postgres store bootstraps only a single JSONB snapshot table and never applies db/migrations/.

blockers.label: Migration foreign-key validity
blockers.policy_reference: db/migrations/0003_benchmarking.sql references projects/reports tables not created by 0001
blockers.resolution_condition: All committed migrations reference only tables/columns created by earlier migrations; FK targets exist.
blockers.description: Migration 0003 references projects(id)/reports(id) that no earlier migration creates; the lineage would fail if applied.

blockers.label: Persistence locking and transactions
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/store.py refresh()->mutate->save() whole-snapshot rewrite with no lock/transaction across processes
blockers.resolution_condition: Multi-entity mutations run under a transaction/lock; no cross-process whole-snapshot last-writer-wins.
blockers.description: Every mutation rewrites the whole snapshot with no cross-process lock or transaction; concurrent writers lose data.

blockers.label: Continuous integration execution
blockers.policy_reference: docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.md (GA readiness-gate integrity follow-up names CI); no .github/ present
blockers.resolution_condition: A CI workflow runs the build and audit:all (and the corpus-backed FORGE evaluation) on every push and blocks merges on failure.
blockers.description: No CI configuration exists anywhere in the repository; the guard battery runs only locally.

blockers.label: Dependency vulnerability scanning
blockers.policy_reference: no pip-audit/pnpm audit/dependabot config in repository
blockers.resolution_condition: A reviewed dependency vulnerability scan (pip-audit and pnpm audit) runs with no unresolved critical/high findings and pinned lockfiles.
blockers.description: No dependency vulnerability scanning of the Python or JS dependency trees exists.

blockers.label: Structured production logging
blockers.policy_reference: docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md service Logging column; no logging module in backend/app
blockers.resolution_condition: Request/worker actions emit structured, redacted, correlation-id-bearing logs.
blockers.description: There is no structured operational logging; only the hash-chained audit log exists.

blockers.label: Metrics and monitoring
blockers.policy_reference: no metrics/monitoring instrumentation in backend/app
blockers.resolution_condition: Request/job counters, latencies, queue depth, and failure rates are exported to a monitored destination with defined alert ownership.
blockers.description: No metrics, monitoring, or alerting integration exists.

blockers.label: Worker heartbeat and retry policy
blockers.policy_reference: docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md S1-07 (worker heartbeat); backend/app/worker.py has no heartbeat/retry
blockers.resolution_condition: The worker emits a liveness heartbeat and applies a documented retry/dead-letter policy; a stuck worker is detectable.
blockers.description: The worker has no heartbeat, no retry policy, and no dead-letter queue; a dead worker is undetectable.

blockers.label: Backup and tested restore
blockers.policy_reference: docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md (Postgres provisioning and backups); no backup/restore in repo
blockers.resolution_condition: A backup mechanism and an evidenced, tested restore drill exist for the production persistence backend with defined RPO/RTO.
blockers.description: There is no backup or restore procedure and no evidence of a restore drill for either the local snapshot or Postgres.

blockers.label: Formatted export provenance
blockers.policy_reference: docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.md (formatted HTML/PDF/XLSX export provenance follow-up)
blockers.resolution_condition: Formatted HTML/PDF/XLSX exports carry per-row source/reference/calculated provenance and confidence matching the UI.
blockers.description: Formatted exports drop the per-row provenance and confidence the UI enforces.

blockers.label: Official-export review gate behavior
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/readiness.py official_export_gate (passes iff a method is callable)
blockers.resolution_condition: The official-export gate is verified by behavior: an unreviewed report cannot officially export, required review blocks it, and provenance is enforced.
blockers.description: The legacy readiness check passed merely because a gating method attribute is callable; the full provenance-enforcing official-export gate is not implemented.

blockers.label: External malware scanner adapter
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/malware.py (clamav/custom adapters hardcoded ready=False, 'not wired yet')
blockers.resolution_condition: A configured external scanner adapter (clamav/custom) is wired, reachable, and blocks a positive sample.
blockers.description: Only the builtin heuristic baseline can satisfy malware scanning; the external scanner adapters are unwired.

blockers.label: Phase 06 local-AI trust boundary
blockers.policy_reference: docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.md Phase 06 (local-AI extraction router unbuilt); docs/MONDAY_REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md Epic 8 (Local AI Extraction, unbuilt)
blockers.resolution_condition: A local-AI extraction router exists with output validation, provenance, timeout/isolation, disabled-by-default posture, and no silent override of deterministic values.
blockers.description: The local-AI extraction router is unbuilt; there is no trust boundary over untrusted-document->LLM content or LLM-output validation.

blockers.label: PostgreSQL production repository adapter (active)
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/production_database_adapter_evidence.py (production-database-adapter-evidence.v1); consumer backend/app/ga_readiness.py::_postgres_adapter_probe
blockers.resolution_condition: A production-database-adapter-evidence.v1 artifact validates against the contract module: a named production target that is NOT a loopback or docker-bridge endpoint, NOT a test, staging or development environment and NOT ephemeral storage, with verified TLS and configured credential rotation; a non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS runtime role that does not own protected tables and is distinct from the migration administrator; full 40-character commit and tree binding to the evaluated head; a strict clean-worktree attestation re-checked at validation time; a verified canonical payload hash; production_parity=true supported by recorded observations rather than a literal; every required production proof domain accepted with domain-appropriate provenance, where recovery and availability domains require an executed drill; and a clean secret scan.
blockers.description: Requires an independently valid, exact-head production database-adapter evidence artifact (production-database-adapter-evidence.v1). The accepted restricted PostgreSQL runtime proves FUNCTIONAL behaviour and tenant isolation in disposable test infrastructure; this control certifies PRODUCTION OPERATIONS -- availability, identity provisioning, network boundary, TLS, backup, restore, capacity, monitoring and recovery -- which that proof does not establish. A postgres repository backend, a reachable or disposable PostgreSQL, the restricted runtime functional matrix, tenant-authorization evidence, the dual-backend UI certification and the test-only bootstrap migration administrator are each explicitly non-qualifying, alone or together.

blockers.label: Redis production queue adapter (active)
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/production_queue_adapter_evidence.py (production-queue-adapter-evidence.v1); consumer backend/app/ga_readiness.py::_queue_adapter_probe
blockers.resolution_condition: A production-queue-adapter-evidence.v1 artifact validates against the contract module: a named production target that is NOT a loopback or docker-bridge endpoint and NOT a test, staging or development environment, with verified TLS, configured credential rotation and an eviction policy that cannot discard a queued job; least-privilege producer and consumer identities that are neither administrative, default nor unauthenticated, an administrative identity separated from them, a per-tenant namespace binding and a rejected payload tenant override; an explicitly declared delivery model with both its loss window and its idempotency compatibility observed; full 40-character commit and tree binding to the evaluated head; a strict clean-worktree attestation re-checked at validation time; a verified canonical payload hash; production_parity=true supported by recorded observations rather than a literal; every required production queue proof domain accepted with domain-appropriate provenance, where failover, recovery, retry, poison-message and duplicate-delivery domains require an executed drill; and a clean secret scan.
blockers.description: Requires an independently valid, exact-head production queue-adapter evidence artifact (production-queue-adapter-evidence.v1). The accepted worker and disposable-queue tests prove controlled SOFTWARE behaviour -- tenant boundaries, retry handling and fail-closed operation; this control certifies PRODUCTION QUEUE availability, durability, identity provisioning and operations, which those tests do not establish. Queue reachability (a liveness ping), redis_queue readiness, a disposable Docker Redis, the restricted worker functional matrix, tenant-authorization evidence, the dual-backend UI certification and production DATABASE-adapter evidence are each explicitly non-qualifying, alone or together. The queue implementation in this repository is not durable or recoverable: delivery is at-most-once, enqueue is a non-atomic SADD+RPUSH, dequeue is an LPOP with no lease or acknowledgement, the resulting loss window is permanent because the dedupe-set entry blocks re-derivation, and there is no retry counter, dead-letter queue or per-tenant namespace in the queue keys.

blockers.label: Production configuration (secrets/paths/limits)
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/readiness.py (client_mode, api_key, signing secret, state/storage/export paths, upload/archive/retention limits, hosted-fallback-disabled)
blockers.resolution_condition: Client mode is enabled and every configuration readiness check (API key >=24, signing secret >=32, out-of-repo state/storage/export paths, upload/archive/retention limits, hosted fallback disabled) passes.
blockers.description: Delegates to the configuration readiness checks; all must pass for production configuration.

blockers.label: Local-AI runtime reachable (narrow)
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/readiness.py local_llm_runtime (endpoint reachable + pinned model available)
blockers.resolution_condition: The configured local-AI runtime is reachable and the pinned model is available (reachability only; not the Phase 06 trust boundary).
blockers.description: Delegates to the local_llm_runtime readiness check. This is only runtime reachability, not the Phase 06 trust boundary (tracked separately).

blockers.label: Parser coverage evidence (promoted FORGE evaluation)
blockers.policy_reference: docs/FORGE_EVAL_PROMOTION.md; evals/forge/manifest.v1.json + expectations.v1.json; output/forge-evals/forge_eval_report.json
blockers.resolution_condition: A fresh corpus-backed FORGE evaluation report exists with 65/65 required PASS and manifest/expectations SHA-256 matching the committed files.
blockers.description: Parser coverage must be evidenced by the promoted FORGE evaluation (report present, 65/65 required, committed manifest/expectations SHAs match), not an env flag.

blockers.label: Reviewed anonymized-client fixture evidence
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/readiness.py parser_fixture_evals + golden_fixture_coverage + reviewed_fixture_attestation
blockers.resolution_condition: All three fixture-evidence readiness checks pass: parser fixture evals, golden fixture coverage, and a reviewed anonymized-client attestation.
blockers.description: Delegates to the fixture-evidence readiness checks; a reviewed anonymized-client fixture manifest and attestation are required.

blockers.label: Clean client state (no demo identity/seed)
blockers.policy_reference: backend/app/readiness.py demo_seed_removed (hardened to reliable identity markers)
blockers.resolution_condition: No demo tenant/user identity markers are present in the active state (detection uses stable identity markers, not a dead audit sentinel).
blockers.description: Delegates to the hardened demo_seed_removed readiness check, which detects demo identity via stable markers rather than a never-emitted audit action.

blockers.label: Client/organizational GA approval
blockers.policy_reference: docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.md (client pilot approval lane); no verified approval mechanism exists
blockers.resolution_condition: A verified, signed client/organizational approval is recorded through a supported mechanism with an authenticated approver identity.
blockers.description: Client/organizational GA approval cannot be represented today because verified approver identity and signature verification do not exist; it remains REVIEW_REQUIRED and blocks GA.
